endorsements.name: Billy Jheng Bing-Jhong
endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Austin 2021 - Schedule and Live Results
endorsements.description:
The STARLabs team of Nguyễn Hoàng Thạch ( @hi_im_d4rkn3ss ) and Billy Jheng Bing-Jhong 
( @st424204 ) combined an OOB Read and a heap-based buffer overflow to exploit the beta version of the 3TB My Cloud Home Personal Cloud from WD. They earn $45,000 and 5 Master of Pwn points.
endorsements.subtitle: Pwn2Own 2021

povs.explanation: Pwn2Own validates successful exploitation through live competition and independent expert verification.
